reason: My kid's birthday is coming up in the next few months and this place doesn't open until next year, so I can't book it. The all-in price is nice, but I'm not putting a deposit on a venue that doesn't exist yet.
objection: It isn't open yet, and I have no idea if it will open on time or be any good. I can't plan a party around a promise.
would_change_my_mind: If it were already open with a firm date before my party and I could read reviews or see a party in person, I'd look at it seriously.
